tc_pretty_name.description: Name of this instance of the X2Go TCE (appears during thinclient boot process)

tc_flavour.description: Select the TCE flavour (classical: 'displaymanager', minimal MATE desktop shell: 'minidesktop')

tc_base.description: Base path for X2Go thin client files

tc_shell.description: Shell to use when maintaining X2Go thin client chroot manually

tc_http_proxy.description: HTTP proxy during debootstrap (leave empty if direct connections to http/ftp are allowed)

tc_https_proxy.description: HTTPS proxy during debootstrap (leave empty if direct connections to http/ftp are allowed)

tc_ftp_proxy.description: FTP proxy during debootstrap (leave empty if direct connections to http/ftp are allowed)

tc_module_blacklist.description: Module blacklist (used during X2Go TCE creation)

tc_tftp_boot.description: TFTP boot environment (PXE/syslinux files delivered via tftpd)
